blocks.text: Qudrat mein koi population akeli nahin rehti. Community un tamam mukhtalif species ki populations ka majmooa hai jo ek hi ilaqe mein reh kar aapas mein ta'alluq rakhti hain. Is mein paude, janwar, fungi aur bacteria sab shamil hain. Maslan Karachi ka Mangrove Forest ek community hai jis mein mangrove ke darakht, mudskipper machhli, kekre (crabs) aur mukhtalif sahili parinde (shorebirds) shamil hain. Yeh sab ek hi jagah mein rehte aur ek doosre se ta'alluq rakhte hain (maslan parinde machhli khate hain).
